subtasks.description: Declare all registers (text_in_r 128-bit, sa 4×4 8-bit, dcnt 4-bit, ld_r 1-bit, text_out 128-bit) and internal combinational signals (sbox bus, round key bus, MixColumns partial products, FSM state wires) as specified in S004.
constraints: Register widths and array dimensions must match S004.

subtasks.description: Instantiate 16 aes_sbox modules, each mapping one state matrix byte, and 1 aes_key_expand_128 module. Connect sbox outputs and round key words (wo_0..3) as combinational buses to the round datapath.
constraints: Key expand and sbox port interfaces must match S014 and S016.

subtasks.description: Implement combinational MixColumns transformation using GF(2^8) multiply-by-2 and XOR, as detailed in S006. May replicate for four columns; output transformed bytes.
constraints: All operations must be purely combinational.
Multiply-by-3 realized as multiply-by-2 XOR original byte, per S006.

subtasks.description: Assemble round datapath: route sbox outputs through SubBytes, apply hardwired ShiftRows, conditionally apply MixColumns (via B3) based on control flag, and XOR with round key (AddRoundKey). Follow transformation order in S006 and S010; final round bypass skips MixColumns (S012).
constraints: Datapath ordering: SubBytes → ShiftRows → MixColumns (if enabled) → AddRoundKey.
Do not embed FSM or dcnt logic; accept a single bypass flag.

subtasks.description: Implement FSM with states IDLE, INIT_ROUND, ROUND_OP, FINAL_ROUND, DONE as per S008. Generate next-state logic (IDLE→INIT_ROUND on ld=1, decrement dcnt initialised 0xB) and control outputs: kld, MixColumns bypass flag, done, per S011.
constraints: State transitions must match the diagram in S008.
dcnt initial value must be 0xB (11) and decrement behavior per S011.

subtasks.description: On rising clk edge (and asynchronous rst), update sa, text_in_r, dcnt, ld_r, text_out according to FSM state and round datapath. Assert done in DONE state. Clear all registers to 0 on reset per S004.
constraints: Register updates must follow data loading (S009) and output generation (S012) sequences.
Reset must clear all registers to 0.
